authority: Operational dispatch mirror only; live main/accepted evidence and canonical Drive governance override this file.

defaults.sourceDependencies: Converged runtime through W18, including Device Plane where implemented
defaults.mission: Converged threat modeling, adversarial tests and remediation across context/cache/events/router/templates/providers/workflows/device, tenant boundaries, secrets, kill-switch and evidence integrity. P0/P1 unresolved blocks release.
sources: - Action Plan v0.4.1 W19 + Device threat amendment

tasks.title: W19-00 - Security Coordination & Threat Model Freeze
actions: 1. Inventory attack surfaces W02-W18 and accepted security invariants.
2. Build converged threat model and prioritize P0/P1/P2 findings.
3. Assign remediation ownership to source wave/component; W19 validates rather than duplicating architecture.
4. Define adversarial harness, secret-handling and release blockers.
5. Create security acceptance matrix including Device Plane when shipped.
tasks.ownership: W19 security/trust tests, shared hardening where explicitly owned, and governance.
tasks.forbidden: Do not create alternate policy/executor/capability architectures.

tasks.title: W19-A - Trust Firewall, Prompt/Tool Injection & Taint
actions: 1. Test malicious user/content/tool/provider outputs against router/context/agents.
2. Implement/validate trust/taint boundaries where required.
3. Ensure tool output cannot become executable instruction/authority without validation.
4. Test indirect prompt injection and poisoned external content.
5. Record exploit evidence and remediation.
tasks.forbidden: Do not rely on model instruction-following alone as security control.

tasks.title: W19-B - Tenant, Data, Privacy & Secret Isolation
actions: 1. Test cross-tenant IDs, cache keys, queues, evidence, provider/account bindings and device bindings.
2. Validate classification/consent/purpose/jurisdiction boundaries.
3. Scan for secret leakage in logs/evidence/cache/templates/telemetry.
4. Test revoked/missing credential and confused-deputy scenarios.
5. Block on any cross-tenant or secret exposure.
tasks.forbidden: Do not weaken fail-closed behavior for availability.

tasks.title: W19-C - Cache / Context / Snapshot Poisoning & Staleness
actions: 1. Attack semantic cache/context retrieval/snapshots with stale, conflicting, poisoned and cross-tenant data.
2. Verify provenance/freshness/invalidation and trust constraints.
3. Ensure stale context/precheck never becomes authority.
4. Test cache-key collision and invalidation lag.
5. Validate safe degrade/abstain.
tasks.forbidden: Do not make cache integrity a substitute for current policy.

tasks.title: W19-D - Event, Queue, Replay & Ordering Abuse
actions: 1. Attack EventEnvelope duplication, replay, out-of-order, forged correlation and queue poisoning.
2. Test idempotency/inbox/outbox/DLQ and replay permissions.
3. Attempt duplicate irreversible side effects.
4. Test event storms/retry storms and resource exhaustion.
5. Validate reconstruction and recovery.
tasks.forbidden: Any uncontrolled duplicate irreversible side effect is release-blocking.

tasks.title: W19-E - Fast Lane, Router & Confidence Manipulation
actions: 1. Attempt to force high-risk tasks into Fast Lane.
2. Spoof confidence/complexity/risk/modality signals.
3. Manipulate strategy/model selection toward cheaper/unsafe routes.
4. Verify mandatory policy/authority/executor stages remain.
5. Test Economic Governor cannot trade safety for cost.
tasks.forbidden: No confidence/router output can grant authority.

tasks.title: W19-F - Template, Speculation & Agent Privilege Drift
actions: 1. Poison PlanTemplate/PlanBinding candidates and attempt stale privilege reuse.
2. Test speculative prep for hidden side effects.
3. Test agent/tool loops, handoff amplification and privilege confusion.
4. Verify promotion provenance/rollback and bounded actions.
5. Exercise over-agentification/kill criteria.
tasks.forbidden: No template/agent may bypass deterministic validation.

tasks.title: W19-G - Provider / Workflow / Credential Threats
actions: 1. Test wrong provider account, forged external ID, credential swap, webhook forgery, n8n workflow tampering and high-risk shell/SSH patterns.
2. Verify provider verification/credential possession != authority.
3. Test rate-limit/timeout ambiguity and reconcile-before-retry.
4. Validate workflow version/hash/provenance.
5. Scan evidence/logs for provider secrets.
tasks.forbidden: Do not enable high-risk shell paths for testing in production.

tasks.title: W19-H - Device Threat Model & Android Attack Matrix
actions: 1. Test session hijack/replay, stolen/revoked/compromised device, malicious deep link, package impersonation, permission drift, stale capability discovery, offline replay, local privilege escalation, Keystore misuse, overlay/UI spoofing and Accessibility abuse.
2. Verify session/permission/app presence never equals authority.
3. Test kill/revoke propagation and stale trust.
4. Attempt duplicate device side effects after reconnect.
5. Record P0/P1 remediation evidence.
tasks.forbidden: Do not bypass Android/platform safety controls.

tasks.title: W19-I - Kill Switch, Receipt/Evidence Forgery & Recovery Security
actions: 1. Attack kill-switch enforcement and cancellation races.
2. Forge/alter/replay Receipt/Evidence and correlation references.
3. Test missing/broken evidence chain under failure.
4. Validate recovery cannot be tricked into duplicate side effects.
5. Exercise audit integrity and incident reconstruction.

tasks.title: W19-J - Integrated Red Team, Remediation Verification & DP6 Security Gate
actions: 1. Run converged attack chains across tenant/context/router/event/executor/provider/workflow/device.
2. Verify every P0/P1 is fixed or release remains blocked.
3. Rerun regression suite after remediation.
4. Run exact-head Security plus Quality/Test Build and document residual risks.
5. Publish W19 acceptance and DP6 security contribution for W20.
tasks.forbidden: No 'accepted risk' for authority bypass, cross-tenant breach, secret exposure or uncontrolled irreversible duplicate side effect.
